issue.summary: FX Spot - Verify rounding for Average Price and Realized PL
issue.description:
**Preconditions**:
1. CRTQA-10176;
2. Instrument of choice is configured to have 5 digit precision (see Peculiarities 1);
3. dxCore console is up and running;
4. Account able to trade FX Spot is `used` (see Peculiarities 2).

**Actions**:
1. Using dxCore console (see CRTQA-10177) from a flat position, imitate the following ladder conditions for Average Price:
- below half at 7th dp
```

BUY +7 @ 1.50001
BUY +1 @ 1.50002
Ref avg: 12.00009 / 8 = 1.50001125
Rounded avg (7 dp): 1.5000113

```
- above half at 7th dp
```

BUY +5 @ 1.50001
BUY +3 @ 1.50002
Ref avg: 12.00011 / 8 = 1.50001375
Rounded avg (7 dp): 1.5000138

```
- exact midpoint at 7th dp (+)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50001
BUY +7 @ 1.50002
Ref avg: 12.00015 / 8 = 1.50001875
Rounded avg (7 dp): 1.5000188

```
- repeating decimal (1/3)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.00000
BUY +2 @ 2.00000
Ref avg (unrounded API): 5 / 3 = 1.666666666666…
Rounded avg (7 dp): 1.6666667

```
- repeating decimal (shifted)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.00001
BUY +2 @ 2.00002
Ref avg (unrounded API): 5.00005 / 3 = 1.666683333333…
Rounded avg (7 dp): 1.6666833

```

2. Using dxCore console, imitate the following ladder conditions for Open PL:
- positive sub-cent (floor truncates toward zero)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50000
Mark Bid: 1.50000045
Unrounded Open PL USD: 0.045 (= 1×(Bid−avg)×100000)
Floor (2 dp): 0.04

```
- positive exact cents
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50000
Mark Bid: 1.50001
Unrounded Open PL USD: 1.00 exact
Floor (2 dp): 1.00

```
- negative sub-cent (floor more negative)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50001
Mark Bid: 1.50000045
Unrounded Open PL USD: −0.955
Floor (2 dp): −0.96

```
- tiny negative crosses to −1 cent
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50000
Mark Bid: 1.49999999
Unrounded Open PL USD: −0.001
Floor (2 dp): −0.01

```
- loss exact cents
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50001
Mark Bid: 1.50000
Unrounded Open PL USD: −1.00 exact
Floor (2 dp): −1.00

```
- unrounded avg drives PL (repeat avg)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.00000
BUY +2 @ 2.00000
(long Q=3; avg_unrounded = 5/3)
Mark Bid: 1.66666675
Unrounded Open PL USD: 0.025
Floor (2 dp): 0.02

```
- repeat avg, negative branch
```

BUY +1 @ 1.00000
BUY +2 @ 2.00000
(long Q=3; avg_unrounded = 5/3)
Mark Bid: 1.66666655
Unrounded Open PL USD: −0.035
Floor (2 dp): −0.04

```

3. Using dxCore console, imitate the following ladder conditions for Realised PL:
- positive sub-cent (floor truncates toward zero)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50000
SELL −1 @ 1.50000045
Unrounded Realized PL USD: 0.045 (= 1×(Sell−avg)×100000)
Floor (2 dp): 0.04

```
- positive exact cents
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50000
SELL −1 @ 1.50001
Unrounded Realized PL USD: 1.00 exact
Floor (2 dp): 1.00

```
- negative sub-cent (floor more negative)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50001
SELL −1 @ 1.50000045
Unrounded Realized PL USD: −0.955
Floor (2 dp): −0.96

```
- tiny loss crosses to −1¢
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50000
SELL −1 @ 1.49999999
Unrounded Realized PL USD: −0.001
Floor (2 dp): −0.01

```
- loss exact cents
```

BUY +1 @ 1.50001
SELL −1 @ 1.50000
Unrounded Realized PL USD: −1.00 exact
Floor (2 dp): −1.00

```
- unrounded avg drives realized (repeat avg)
```

BUY +1 @ 1.00000
BUY +2 @ 2.00000
(long Q=3; avg_unrounded = 5/3)
SELL −3 @ 1.66666675
Unrounded Realized PL USD: 0.025
Floor (2 dp): 0.02

```
- repeat avg, negative branch
```

BUY +1 @ 1.00000
BUY +2 @ 2.00000
(long Q=3; avg_unrounded = 5/3)
SELL −3 @ 1.66666655
Unrounded Realized PL USD: −0.035
Floor (2 dp): −0.04

```

**Results**:
1. Position average price is calculated as expected per CRT-1740 / DXINV-192.
2. Open PL (instrument currency, USD) is calculated as expected per CRT-1743 / DXINV-181.
3. Realized PL (instrument currency, USD) is calculated as expected per CRT-1738 / DXINV-326.

**Peculiarities**:
1. E.g., in dxCore console:
```

antonfx> update instrument EURUSD.spot priceIncrements=0.00001
antonfx> grep priceInc show instrument EURUSD.spot
priceInc: 0.00001

```
2. E.g., in dxCore console:
```

> use 11004
antonfx>

```
